description.narrative: Institutional strengthening (IS) projects have been funded by the Executive Committee since its 7th meeting to provide financial support to Article 5 countries to strengthen their capacity to facilitate expeditious and effective implementation of ozone depleting substances (ODS) phase-out projects, ensuring liaison between the country concerned, the Executive Committee, the Fund Secretariat, and the implementing agencies. These projects have been were fundamental in ensuring wide compliance with the Montreal Protocol. In Armenia, the institutional strengthening project has several objectives, as following: (1) Adoption/implementation of legislation and regulation to control and monitor the imports and use of Montreal Protocol controlled substances and equipment; (2) Accurate and timely data collection and reporting of consumption of all Montreal Protocol controlled substances; (3) Strengthening coordination between national agencies/stakeholders to support the objectives of the Montreal Protocol; (4) Supervision of timely implementation of HCFC phase out/HFC phase down activities and the resulting reduction in consumption of controlled substances; (5) Promoting awareness raising and information exchange on relevant issues of the Montreal Protocol; (6) Regional cooperation and participation in Montreal Protocol
